mapper.insert: INSERT /* SwatAaaDAO.logInsertWebLogSummary */ INTO COMTSWEBLOGSUMMARY SELECT DATE_FORMAT(b.OCCRRNC_DE, '%Y%m%d' ) , b.URL , COUNT(DATE_FORMAT(b.OCCRRNC_DE, '%Y-%m-%d' )) AS RDCNT FROM COMTNWEBLOG b WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(c.OCCRRNC_DE, '%Y-%m-%d' ) FROM COMTSWEBLOGSUMMARY c WHERE DATE_FORMAT(c.OCCRRNC_DE, '%Y%m%d') = DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE(SYSDATE(), -1), '%Y%m%d') ) AND DATE_FORMAT(b.OCCRRNC_DE, '%Y%m%d' ) = DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE(SYSDATE(), -1), '%Y%m%d') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(b.OCCRRNC_DE, '%Y%m%d' ) , b.URL
mapper.delete: DELETE /* SwatAaaDAO.logDeleteWebLogSummary */ FROM COMTNWEBLOG WHERE DATE_FORMAT(OCCRRNC_DE, '%Y-%m-%d') < DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE(SYSDATE(), INTERVAL -6 MONTH), '%Y-%m-%d')
